# Bloomseed Temporary Assets

Source: https://cocophany.itch.io/bloomseed

Downloaded file: `Bloomseed-Free-Asset-Pack-1.2.0.zip`

Extracted source: `source/Bloomseed - Free Asset Pack/`

Use in this project: temporary prototype art for tilemap, farming interactions, props, and animation tests. These assets are not intended to become final project art.

License notes from the included `Read_me.txt`:

- Credit is required: `Assets from Bloomseed by Cocophany`.

- Commercial and non-commercial project use is allowed.

Replacement note: when custom art is ready, remove this directory and any references to `assets/third_party/temp/bloomseed/`.
